author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes: Adds and controls a Meross MSG100 WiFi Garage Door Opener as a Hubitat device: open/close, live door and contact status, and configurable polling. Setup logs into your Meross account once to retrieve the device's local control key, then finds the device on your LAN automatically (network scan) or lets you enter its IP manually. Once set up, control runs entirely over your local network - no ongoing cloud dependency. Latest (2.2.0): renamed the app/driver to 'Meross MSG100 Garage Door Setup' / 'Meross MSG100 Garage Door'.
